title: "Centroids Lookup Table Creation Script"
format: html
---

```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from haversine import haversine, Unit

load_dotenv()
```

```{python}
# setup connection variables to local sql db
database_url = os.getenv("DATABASE_URL")
engine = create_engine(database_url)
```

```{python}
# Load required tables
dc_df = pd.read_sql_table("data_centers", engine)
county_df = pd.read_sql_table("us_counties", engine)
```

## Prepare Dataframes for merging

```{python}
dc_lookup = dc_df[["data_center_id", "lon", "lat"]].copy()
county_lookup = county_df[["county_id", "centroid_lon", "centroid_lat"]].copy()
```

## Cross-Join Dataframes

```{python}
lookup_df = county_lookup.merge(dc_lookup, how="cross")
```

## Calculate Haversine Distance

```{python}
lookup_df["distance_miles"] = lookup_df.apply(
    lambda row: haversine(
        (row["centroid_lat"], row["centroid_lon"]),
        (row["lat"], row["lon"]),
        unit = Unit.MILES
    ),
    axis = 1
)
```

## Update County table to use closest data center distance

```{python}
nearest_dc_idx = lookup_df.groupby("county_id")["distance_miles"].idxmin()

nearest_dc = lookup_df.loc[
    nearest_dc_idx,
    ["county_id", "data_center_id", "distance_miles"]
    ].rename(columns = {"distance_miles": "min_distance_to_dc_mi", "data_center_id": "nearest_dc_id"})
```

```{python}
final_county_df = county_df.copy().merge(nearest_dc, on = "county_id", how = "left")
```
